suite: switch/launch pipeline through IPC, real services and adapters, launcher simulators
name: 3b. Cancel (Epic) after the write but before the launcher starts: the file is put back

steps.title: Save the outgoing session
steps.detail: [RememberMe] holds Main's session; store it, encrypted, as the account's snapshot if it changed. Nothing in the launcher's files changes.

steps.title: Back up GameUserSettings.ini
steps.detail: Copy {tmp}\Local\EpicGamesLauncher\Saved\Config\Windows\GameUserSettings.ini into a new snapshot folder so a failed switch can be rolled back. The newest 20 snapshots are kept.

changes.after: (from the same snapshot, or removed when it has none)

steps.title: Put the account's session in place
steps.detail: Decrypt Alt's session snapshot from the vault and write it into [RememberMe] (Enable=True and Data) and [Offline] (Data) of GameUserSettings.ini. The new content is written to a temp file and renamed over the original. Every other line, including the per-account [<id>_*] sections, stays byte for byte. The blob itself is never shown or logged.

steps.title: Start Epic Games Launcher
steps.detail: Start the launcher normally (no arguments, as the com.epicgames.launcher:// handler does). It signs in as alt@example.com on its own from [RememberMe].

steps.title: Wait for the launcher to come up
steps.detail: Poll the process list until EpicGamesLauncher.exe is running, up to 3 s.

steps.title: Confirm the launcher signed in
steps.detail: Read what the launcher appends to its own log (no tokens in it) until FAccountService::OnLoginComplete reports TRUE with the Epic account id …222222, up to 0.2 s. A FALSE line means the launcher did not sign in and the next step hands over to you; when the reason is a refused token (for example TOKEN_EXPIRED) the snapshot is also marked stale.

steps.title: Wait for you to sign in
steps.detail: Runs only if the launcher rejects the stored session (expired token) or does not sign in within 0.2 s. The launcher stays open on its sign-in page; you sign in there once as alt@example.com and One Launch continues with the game as soon as the log reports the sign-in, up to 0.03333333333333333 min.

steps.title: Save the new session
steps.detail: Runs only after a manual sign-in: the fresh [RememberMe] replaces the stale snapshot.

result.closeMessage: Epic Games Launcher is running. Switching closes it.

steps.title: Save the outgoing session
steps.detail: Main's stored session is already current.

steps.detail: [RememberMe] now holds the snapshot (fingerprint 79a15d60) in 1 file.
